decisions.decision: Marker colors: red (Critical), orange (High), teal (Medium), violet (Low)
decisions.rationale: Nominatim's red+amber+yellow were indistinguishable. Switched to 4 distinct spectral bands.
Markers now encode both severity (color) and status (symbol) for quick visual scan.

decisions.decision: Marker icon inner elements must use stroke=white, not fill=white
decisions.rationale: fill=white is invisible against the white background circle. The .replace() only changes stroke=white to severity color.

decisions.decision: Replaced Nominatim with Photon for geocoding
decisions.rationale: Photon has no strict rate limit, better non-English support (Indian addresses), no User-Agent header needed, faster response.
